ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
The electric field produced by a uniformly charged spherical shell in the space outside the sphere is equivalent to the electric field produced by the charge concentrated at the center of the sphere. As shown in the figure, positive charge is uniformly distributed on the hemispherical surface AB, with total charge q and spherical surface radius R. CD is the axis passing through the vertex of the hemisphere and the sphere center O. On the axis there are two points M and N, OM＝ON＝2R. It is known that the magnitude of the field strength at point M is E, then the magnitude of the field strength at point N is (　　)
A．${\frac{\mathrm{kq}}{2\mathrm{R}^{2}}}-\mathrm{E}$
B．$\frac{\mathrm{kq}}{4\mathrm{R}^{2}}$
C．${\frac{\mathrm{kq}}{4\mathrm{R}^{2}}}-\mathrm{E}$
D．${\frac{\mathrm{kq}}{4\mathrm{R}^{2}}}+\mathrm{E}$

As shown in the figure, positive charge is uniformly distributed on the hemispherical surface AB, with total charge q and spherical surface radius R. ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the positively charged hemispherical surface AB is drawn on the left side of the sphere center O, and multiple “+” signs are marked on the hemispherical surface; CD is a horizontal axis passing through O, point M is on the left side of O, point N is on the right side of O, and the problem states OM=ON=2R. In the figure there is a radius mark R from O to the hemispherical surface. Then reason: Use the completion method. Add on the right side of O a hemispherical surface that is symmetric with the original hemispherical surface AB about O and has the same surface charge density; then the total charge of the added hemispherical surface is also q. The original hemispherical surface and the added hemispherical surface form a complete uniformly charged spherical shell with radius R and total charge 2q. According to the conclusion given in the problem, the magnitude of the field strength of the complete spherical shell at a distance 2R from O outside the sphere is equivalent to the field strength produced by charge 2q concentrated at O, so at point N the magnitude of the field strength of the complete spherical shell is k(2q)/(2R)^2 = kq/(2R^2). Since M and N are symmetric about O, the magnitude of the field strength produced by the original left hemisphere at point M is E, so the magnitude of the field strength produced by the added right hemisphere at point N is also E. The field strength of the complete spherical shell at point N is equal to the vector sum of the field strength produced by the original left hemisphere at point N and the field strength produced by the added right hemisphere at point N; at point N the directions of both are along the axis to the right, so the magnitudes are added. Therefore the magnitude of the field strength produced by the original left hemisphere at point N is the field strength of the complete spherical shell minus the contribution of the added right hemisphere, namely kq/(2R^2)-E.

method.method_draft: 先从图中读出：带正电的半球面AB位于球心O的左侧，CD是水平轴线，M在O左侧、N在O右侧，且二者到O的距离均为2R。用“补全法”：在O右侧补上一个与AB对称、面电荷密度相同的半球面，则补上的半球面总电荷也为q，二者组成总电荷为2q、半径为R的均匀带电完整球壳。由题给球壳定理，完整球壳在外部距O为2R处的场强大小为 k(2q)/(2R)^2 = kq/(2R^2)。图中M、N关于O左右对称，原左半球在M点产生的场强大小为E，所以补上的右半球在N点产生的场强大小也为E。完整球壳在N点的场强等于“原左半球在N点的场强”与“补上右半球在N点的场强”的矢量和；二者均沿轴线向右，因此大小相加。故原左半球在N点的场强大小为 kq/(2R^2) - E。
